sections.title: Generated dialogue performances
sections.body:
Character speech is generated with the full-precision Kokoro-82M v1.0 model, using a consistent voice recipe for each member of the cast. These are synthetic performances, not recordings by a human cast or cloned actor voices. No human listening or performance review has been performed.

Kokoro model weights by hexgrad are licensed under Apache 2.0. The kokoro-onnx inference runtime by thewh1teagle is MIT licensed. Speech generation and its dependencies are build-time tools; the game distributes compressed recordings and provenance, not the model or inference runtime.

Earlier Piper/VCTK attribution remains in the production documentation for historical provenance.

sections.title: Generated journal illustrations
sections.body: The four chapter illustrations in the journal atlas were created with OpenAI image generation for Ashen Oath. Story text and interface labels remain runtime text, separate from the illustrations.
